The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Cause of the Issue
In [`MultiplePiePlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_d_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L143-L146), the constructor `MultiplePiePlot(CategoryDataset dataset)` assigned `this.dataset = dataset;` directly without registering itself as a change listener with the dataset.

### Solution
Modified [`MultiplePiePlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_d_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L145) to invoke `setDataset(dataset);` in the constructor, which properly registers the plot as a listener on the dataset.

### Patch
The focused patch has been generated and saved to [enlightened_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
